text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work. Right now, I am offering 
detailed explanations of the "Great 
Harvest Festival" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: <username>, do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what would you like me to 
explain?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of things to ask regarding 
training in the "Great Harvest Festival"—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You want to know about the "Cooking 
Challenge," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The "Cooking Challenge" is an event where 
participants try their hand at making 
various dishes to deepen their 
appreciation for food.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A total of four "Tasting Parties" will be 
held, where everyone will cook dishes 
using the harvested vegetables and 
taste-test them together.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the "Cooking Pt" earned 
before each tasting session, the 
Umamusume's satisfaction level at the 
"Tasting Event" will also change.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you leave everyone thoroughly 
satisfied, their cooking motivation will 
rise, changing the effects of the dishes 
made! The Umamusume will also be able to 
grow tremendously!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's deepen our understanding of 
vegetables and cooking—and do our best so 
our Umamusume can grow strong and healthy 
on better meals♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And then... in late December of the Senior 
year, the final cooking challenge, the 
"Great Harvest Festival," will be held!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A major event where you can make full use 
of the culinary knowledge you've gathered 
so far... Please treat all the 
participants to your signature dishes!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, while participating in the 
Twinkle Series, everyone will also be 
taking part in the Cooking Challenge.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that depending on training 
conditions, your training may conclude 
even during the Cooking Challenge, so 
please take extra care!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation for the 
Cooking Challenge. Is there anything else 
you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About 'Harvesting Vegetables', right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This time, we will harvest five types of 
vegetables, make dishes that aid in 
training, and aim to achieve our training 
goals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
All types of vegetables are harvested 
every 4 turns, and the harvest yield 
changes based on the Lv of each vegetable.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The "Field Pts" required to raise a 
vegetable's Lv can be acquired whenever 
you harvest.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And—by carrying out each training session, 
you can earn 'Care Stamps' for various 
vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Vegetables that have earned Care Stamps 
can be harvested in larger quantities than 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way, you can also earn Grooming 
Stamps by choosing "Rest," "Go Out," 
"Infirmary," or "Race."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However... the types of Grooming Stamps 
you can obtain outside of training vary 
each time, so please check carefully.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, satisfying conditions like 
Friendship Training—will transform your 
Care Stamp into a 'Full Power Care Stamp'!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The more Full-Power Care stamps you get, 
the more your harvest increases!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Efficiently harvest vegetables and cook 
more dishes to boost your training 
effects! Please do your best!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes the explanation for 
'Harvesting Vegetables.' Is there anything 
else you'd like to ask?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About "Cooking", then.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By using the vegetables required by a 
recipe, you can prepare "Dishes."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Every time you cook, you'll earn Cooking 
Pts, which affect the satisfaction level 
at the Tasting Event!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, but by eating these dishes, 
you can gain various effects!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
For instance, boosting basic stats and 
Skill Pt gained from training and races, 
restoring energy, and so on♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also... sometimes, dishes can turn out to 
be a 'Great Success.'

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When a dish is a "Great Success," you can 
gain various additional bonuses on top of 
the normal meal's effects!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, with each Tasting Session you 
complete, the effects gained from dishes 
will increase, and you'll be able to cook 
new recipes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep building up our cooking 
experience and put it to good use in our 
training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation about 
"Cooking." Is there anything else you 
would like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About the “Field,” right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By leveling up your Vegetable Lv in the 
field, you can harvest more vegetables and 
boost the effects of your cooking.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To raise a vegetable's Lv, you will need 
the "Field Pts" obtained during 
harvesting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that the higher a vegetable's 
Lv, the more "Field Pts" will be required.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, there's a cap on Vegetable Lv, 
but... by satisfying everyone at the 
Tasting Events, you'll be able to aim for 
even higher levels!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation regarding 
the “Field.” Is there anything else you'd 
like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a 
brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any 
time by tapping the 'i' button in the top 
left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck. I'll be cheering 
you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best, 
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
